title: RLVR training task (CorpusTask)
description: One verifiable RLVR training game the base agent trains on (zetta#866). Mirrors zetta::agent::CorpusTask / AdmissionCase; the native loader (agent/corpus_io.hpp) and admission gate re-check it before training. Every generated task MUST validate against this schema.

initial_state.description: The world before the agent acts — data available + any pasted current_state (n8n/sql/notebook/prose) the user wants improved.

required.description: The checkable success criterion — objectively verifiable facts of a correct built graph. A task with no required facts is untrainable and MUST be rejected.

reference.description: The reference solution's facts — MUST satisfy every required fact (passes the grader).

negative_controls.description: Plausible-wrong solutions — each MUST fail >= 1 required fact (discrimination is the product).
